feeds.title: Americana UK
feeds.description: Americana UK is a digital publication that covers the latest news and reviews from the Americana music scene. With a focus on roots, country, and folk music, Americana UK provides a platform for emerging artists to gain exposure and connect with audiences. Founded in 2001, the publication has established itself as a leading voice in the Americana music community.

feeds.title: Elmore Magazine
feeds.description: Elmore Magazine covers American music with a deep knowledge and respect for its historical traditions. They seek to cover the best in blues, folk, Americana, country, rock, soul, jazz, and many more.

feeds.title: Americana Highways
feeds.description: Americana Highways is on the road collecting the stories of Americana music. We collect stories, reviews & photos about Americana and roots-rock music & musicians.

feeds.title: Ear To The Ground Music » Americana
feeds.description: EarToTheGround Music features emerging Americana musicians. Providing album reviews, artist interviews, and artist features for independent and musicians in need of press coverage.

feeds.title: Post To Wire » Americana
feeds.description: Post To Wire is a blog dedicated to the different strands of Americana music. We publish reviews, interviews, news, and multimedia content from alt-country, folk, blues, and rock 'n' roll artists from Australia, New Zealand, and around the world.

feeds.title: Featured on Louder Than War » Americana Reviews
feeds.description: Read all about Americana music reviews on Louder Than War, the home of contemporary music, film & culture. Louder Than War is a music, culture, and media publication. It is one of the fastest-growing and most respected music-related publications on the net.

feeds.title: A&R Factory » Americana
feeds.description: Find the latest Americana music submitted by various artists on our New Americana music blog. Since 2012, we have grown into one of the most respected artist and repertoire (A&R) blogs. We help music industry professionals discover new independent music from across the world.

feeds.title: Carte Blanche Music » americana
feeds.description: Get to know the latest signles and album tracks from the Americana genre in here. This blog is a continuation of the radio show Carte Blanche, which has been broadcast in the Netherlands for almost 30 years! Carte Blanche Radio presented new music only and Carte Blanche Music will continue to do so.

feeds.title: The Ark of Music » Americana
feeds.description: The Ark of Music is your go-to source to read more about Americana music from the new releases to rising artists and more. The Ark of Music strives to enrich the music culture by connecting independent and small-label musicians with the music-loving public. We post full-service reviews of the best music in the world you never knew existed.

feeds.title: Right Chord Music Blog » Americana
feeds.description: Explore our articles on Americana music, the latest news and more! Right Chord Music (RCM) is the unsigned music blog. We've been championing incredible unsigned and independent artists since 2010.

feeds.title: Digital High » Americana
feeds.description: Get the latest news and updates from the Americana music industry. Digital High is one guy's attempt at engrossing himself and others with the latest and greatest the vast musical universe has to offer. It's all about discovering new sounds and styles and making sure they're heard in today's crowded creative market.

feeds.title: Rock The Pigeon » Americana
feeds.description: Explore our articles covering the Americana music industry, artists' news and more! Rock The PigeonN started as an anonymously written music blog based in Oakland, California. Over the past few years we have expanded our writers throughout the United States. We cover all types of music, art, culture, and stories from all around the world.

feeds.title: One Chord To Another
feeds.description: One Chord To Another is a Finnish pop site. Or at least once was, but after 20 years or so it's difficult to change the subtitle. When I started this on the 17th of September, 2001, the main focus was on Finnish pop music, but over the years it has drifted more and more towards the country, folk and Americana. Most of the music on this blog will fit into genres such as guitar pop, power pop, indie pop, sunshine pop, country, alt-country, Americana, folk, etc.

feeds.title: The Rocking Magpie
feeds.description: Welcome to the Rocking Magpie - a box-room on the Internet for one man and a bunch of his Roots Music loving friend's thoughts and musings on a wide variety of music, be it CDs, Gigs, books and the occasional DVD. Usually; but not exclusively based around all things Roots; Americana, Folk, Blues, R&B, all variants of Country, a bit of Ska, Reggae and Soul.

feeds.title: Twangville
feeds.description: Twangville is a Music Review blog featuring Alt-Country, Americana, Indie, Rock, Folk & Blues. Emphasizing the Alt side of Alt-country, we cover releases, reviews, downloads, links, and more. Explore Reader's Picks, Artist interviews, and more in our latest posts.

feeds.title: Sportsmen's Americana Music Foundation Blog
feeds.description: Since its formation just over three years ago, along with celebrating, supporting, and promoting the tremendous talent we have in Western NY, SAMF has been committed to getting music into the ears and instruments into the hands of as many kids as possible. Our mission is to foster, promote and expand community appreciation for Americana music.

feeds.title: Americana Music Appreciation Crossroads
feeds.description: Crossroads - Americana Music Appreciation is a website that celebrates and explores the musical genre now known as Americana. In its review of Americana Music, Crossroads places a particular emphasis on the lyrical composition of songs and the poetic influences within.

feeds.title: Amplify Music Magazine » Americana
feeds.description: Amplify Music Magazine is your source to read about Americana and its adventure. The magazine features announcements, reviews, interviews, and concert coverage.

feeds.title: Americana One

feeds.title: A Haven For Songs

feeds.title: The Indy Review » Americana
